mission: Turn E14's data-vs-features ranking into evidence-backed action: quantify expected gain per N new labels for the most label-starved subsystem (with bounds and stated assumptions) and generate the concrete label-acquisition plan.
environment: LINUX-CPU, artifact-join only. No pipeline stage executed, no run dir touched, no bench re-measured, no production code modified. All numbers derive from committed artifacts.

datasetScope.heldOutDiscipline: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched. The 15 fresh candidates remain label-blind: only committed registry metadata quoted; the plan explicitly gates any labeling on an integrator split-freeze through the D-024 acquisition front door.

metrics.mostDataStarvedSubsystem: stroke (the only LABEL_STARVED E14 call: dev corpus saturated 29/29, 4 of 9 L1 families at zero gold)

taCurveFit.conclusion: TA has plateaued: +50 same-distribution labels buys ~0.01 accuracy vs the +0.178 the committed candidate config already measures on identical cases. Same-distribution TA labeling is quantitatively the worst use of annotation effort.

strokeCurveExtrapolation.provenNegative: SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE for accuracy extrapolation: the stroke curve has 2 points / 3 joined units; a 3-parameter saturating fit is unidentifiable, so any accuracy-per-label number would be fabricated.

quantifiedInstead.measurability: 12 labels/family (95% Wilson half-width ≤0.25 at worst-case p=0.5) × 4 zero-gold families (return, drop_reset, attack_counter, specialty) = 48 labels lifts L1 measurability 5/9 → 9/9; 21/family (+36 labels) tightens to ≤0.20.
quantifiedInstead.groupWidthPrior: Transferred TA width-vs-groups fit w(G)=0.587/√G (stated assumption, not a stroke measurement) predicts curve interval width ≈0.24 at 6 session groups vs 0.415 at 2 → spread new labels across ≥6 new session groups.

metrics.taSliceSampleSizes: Contested-session slice estimates to Wilson half-width ≤0.15: sasebo +32, sigonella +26, marne +19, wm-tournament +20 verified cases (warriorgames already at 0.143).

orderedActions: P1: Mac prediction pass — 0 labels, converts 3 MEASUREMENT_LIMITED verdicts to real calls (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: requires macOS/Apple Vision)
P2: TA feature/config work, not labels (curve fit proves labels ~worthless)

P3: 48 stroke-event labels (12/family × 4 zero-gold families) from NEW footage across ≥6 session groups; 15 registry-listed candidate clips enumerated with per-family content targeting; labeling gated on D-024 split-freeze
P4: 16 contact labels on edge-on/occluded events from the same new clips
P5: 97 TA verified cases to sharpen contested slice estimates (does not move aggregate)

gates.tests: no package source touched (analysis script + wave-f artifacts only); root typecheck/lint cover the workspace

externalBlockers: Priority-1 Mac prediction pass remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL (no macOS/Apple Vision in this environment) — recorded as a plan dependency, not fabricated
